name: Apollo Tyres Ltd
title: Apollo Tyres Ltd - 500877 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 India volumes up high teens with capacity utilisation at 90%, but raw-material basket up mid-to-high teens forces 6-8% price hikes; Europe margin still 14.6% versus historic 16%+.

utilisation.quote: The capacity utili sation was at a high of 90% across both our India and Europe Operations.

capex.quote: For FY'27, we have outlined a CapEx of INR 35 billion, with nearly 80% towards growth and capacity expansion projects.

triggers.label: Utilisation at 90% across India and Europe
triggers.quote: The capacity utili sation was at a high of 90% across both our India and Europe Operations.

triggers.label: Price hikes 6-8%, about half of needed
triggers.quote: We've taken about half the price increase that is needed. So at least a couple of more rounds of price increases would be needed

triggers.label: FY27 capex INR 35bn, ~80% growth
triggers.quote: For FY'27, we have outlined a CapEx of INR 35 billion, with nearly 80% towards growth and capacity expansion projects.

triggers.label: Enschede closure, H2 FY27 margin benefit
triggers.quote: So in H2 of FY '27, the positive impact of margins as we become more cost competitive for our European operations should start flowing in.

guidance.value: mid to high teens sequential increase
guidance.quote: Raw material costs are expected to rise in high teens on a sequential basis.
we have already announced price increases of 6 % to 8% for this current quarter. More price increases would further be needed.

we will get back to a 16% which was our earlier normal, and in fact, we believe we can even surpass that.

red_flags.label: Enschede write-off EUR 43m and EUR 55m cash provision
red_flags.quote: a non -cash write-off of EUR 43 million has been taken on the fixed assets this quarter.

red_flags.label: Q1 margins under pressure from RM spike
red_flags.quote: the geopolitical developments in West Asia have added significant volatility to raw material, energy, and logistics costs, which will impact margins in near term.

evasions.quote: How would Q2 look? Difficult to predict as of now.
How the second half pans out, right now, things are just too volatile to be able to make any definitive statement.
